# RenG

Canonical documentation: https://rohittp.com/reng/
KMP setup: https://rohittp.com/reng/kmp.html
Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG
Architecture decisions: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG/tree/main/docs/adr

Maven coordinate: com.rohittp.reng:kmp
Public Maven repository: https://maven.rohittp.com
Public release status: available; read Maven metadata for the current version

Published Kotlin Multiplatform targets (all six ship in every release):
- android — host tests run on the JVM; no GL is executed
- iosArm64 — compilation only
- iosSimulatorArm64 — compilation only
- macosArm64 — test suite runs, including GL conformance against a real context
- linuxX64 — test suite runs, including GL conformance against a real context on Mesa llvmpipe
- linuxArm64 — compilation only

Publication and execution are separate claims. Android and iOS bring-up on real devices is a planned
cycle that has not happened yet.

License: Apache-2.0

Releases are immutable and fail closed. Every non-documentation push to main publishes only after
validation; an occupied coordinate, malformed response, or validation failure stops publication rather
than overwriting or skipping a version. Routine next-patch advancement requires the newest metadata-listed
release's strict record at com/rohittp/reng/kmp/<version>/reng-release-completion-v1.json. POM and metadata
availability are not completion proof. The workflow conditionally creates the record only after anonymous
artifact/metadata verification and credential-free six-target resolution, then verifies it anonymously.

Every public completion record so far verified anonymously from its exact CI-passing source commit. ADR
0013 and the Cycle A design spec and implementation plan remain historical decision records. Public
version display remains metadata-driven; do not quote a RenG version from this file.

What the published release does

RenG draws. createRenderer is public API. It adopts the OpenGL context the caller has already made
current, takes a FramePlan describing the complete on-screen state, and draws that frame into a
caller-supplied framebuffer. Frame preparation and drawing are separate operations. The release draws
PNG stickers anchored to the map or to the screen, and lat/lon-bounded quads painted by consumer-supplied
GLSL ES 3.00 shader pairs with consumer-supplied uniforms and textures.

What it does not do

The published release draws no GLB models, no terrain, and no map labels, and it rejects the GLOBE
projection mode. A plan that requests the basemap without a configured style does not fail; it draws
none, and warns. Basemap drawing is execution-verified on macosArm64 and linuxX64 only. RenG owns no window, render loop, capture path, or encoder. It performs no network I/O and keeps
no persistent cache: transport and store are adapters the consumer injects, and RenG only follows the
supplied plan. This file describes the current release, not unreleased work.
